family: Integer partial two-address rows; N2,m1 spectral primitive templates exhaust the analytic exceptional domain. Actual Boolean guards include three-bit defect and A032 six-bit witness.
parameter_domain: N2,m1: (1,2),(1,2),(1,1) with scale2 and (1,3),(1,3),(1,1) with scale1; all256 Fourier phases per template. N3,m2: all8 primitive2/3 pair choices, rejected by parity or signed singleton moment. All25 two-value integer rows for N1,m0. One8-sign defect and one64-sign source witness.
symmetry: Swap primitive pair entries by multiplying the physical row by a character; reorder spectral coordinates. Both preserve physical absolute values and integer height; no Fourier phase quotient.
arithmetic: Integer direct character sums, gcd, Fraction; exact rational logarithm intervals for constant checks.
